camel_example: aliyun iot CreateProductTopic --region cn-hangzhou --TopicShortName submit --Operation PUB --ProductKey aldDEin0000
description_en: Creates a custom topic category for a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品创建自定义Topic类
kebab_example: aliyun iot create-product-topic --product-key aldDEin0000 --topic-short-name submit --operation PUB --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateProductTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If the ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the invocation failed.
If the Overview page or ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product for which you want to create a topic category
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The custom category name of the topic category.

The topic format must use `/` to separate levels. Category names can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each level cannot be empty.

You can use the wildcards `+` and `#` to customize topic categories only when Operation is set to SUB (subscribe). This allows devices to subscribe to topics in batches. For more information about the method to use wildcards, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html.

For cloud gateway products, the topic category is fully customized by the user. The `${deviceName}` wildcard can be used to represent the DeviceName.
For non-cloud gateway products, the first three levels of the topic category are fixed as `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/`. Settings for TopicShortName provide the padding to complete the topic category
parameters.help_zh:
设置Topic类的自定义类目名称。

Topic格式必须以`/`进行分层，区分每个类目。类目命名只能包含字母、数字和下划线（_），每级类目不能为空。

Operation为SUB（订阅）时，才可以使用通配符`+`和`#`自定义Topic类，以便设备实现批量订阅Topic。通配符使用方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html 。

对于云网关产品，Topic类完全由用户自定义输入。支持使用`${deviceName}`通配DeviceName。
对于非云网关产品，自定义Topic类前三个类目已固定为`/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/`，定义TopicShortName将Topic类填充完整
parameters.name: topic_short_name

parameters.help_en:
The operation permissions of devices on the topic category. Valid values:

SUB: subscribe.
PUB: publish.
ALL: publish and subscribe
parameters.help_zh:
设备对该Topic类的操作权限，取值：

SUB：订阅。
PUB：发布。
ALL：发布和订阅
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The description of the topic category. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: Topic类的描述信息。长度限制为100字符（一个中文汉字占一个字符）
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable proxy subscription when Operation is set to SUB (subscribe) or ALL (publish and subscribe). Valid values:

true: Enable proxy subscription.
false: Do not enable proxy subscription.

After proxy subscription is enabled, IoT Platform queries the topics with proxy subscription enabled when a device connects to IoT Platform, and subscribes to the topics on behalf of the device
parameters.help_zh:
Operation为SUB（订阅）或ALL（发布和订阅），可开启代理订阅。
取值：

true：开启。
false：不开启。

开启代理订阅后，设备与物联网平台建连时，物联网平台查询已开启代理订阅的Topic，帮助设备完成订阅
parameters.name: enable_proxy_subscribe

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable data compression or decompression for the custom topic under an Enterprise instance. Valid values:

compress: compression.
decompress: decompression.

For more information about the data compression feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html.

<notice>When TopicShortName contains wildcards (`+` and `#`), you cannot specify Codec at the same time. If you enable data compression or decompression when creating a wildcard topic category, the invocation of this operation failed.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
尊享型企业版实例下，可开启自定义Topic数据压缩或解压缩。
取值：

compress：压缩。
decompress：解压缩。

数据压缩功能详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html。

<notice>TopicShortName传入通配符（`+`和`#`）时，不可同时传入Codec。如果创建通配Topic类的同时，开启了数据压缩或解压缩功能，调用本接口创建该Topic类会失败。
</notice>
parameters.name: codec

The topic ID generated by IoT Platform for the new topic category if the invocation is successful.

Keep this information safe. You may need to provide the topic ID when you invoke operations related to this topic category
